In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one La and two H atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one S atom.
